subject: general
question: What was the theme of the first Global Conference on Manuscript Heritage held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, in 2025?

options.text: Preserving India’s Ancient Wisdom through Heritage Studies
Digital Archives for Cultural Knowledge through Heritage Tools
Reviving Asian Manuscript Traditions through Shared Heritage
Reclaiming India’s Knowledge Legacy through Manuscript Heritage

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reclaiming India’s Knowledge Legacy through Manuscript Heritage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first **Global Conference on Manuscript Heritage** was held in **January 2025** at the iconic **Bharat Mandapam**, located in **Pragati Maidan**, **New Delhi**.
 
• The event was inaugurated by the **Prime Minister** of India, **Narendra Modi**, highlighting the importance of ancient texts in the modern era.
 
• The official theme of the conference was **"Reclaiming India’s Knowledge Legacy through Manuscript Heritage"**, which focused on the restoration and global recognition of Indian intellectual history. ***Hence, statement 4 is correct.***
 
• The conference aimed to create a roadmap for the **digitization** and **preservation** of over **10 million** manuscripts currently housed in various institutions across India.
